versions.content: Csm APIs returning failure code behavior Throughout this chapter the Csm or KeyM are used to process the authentication requests. These APIs have return values for failures. Unless there is no dedicated requirement for a given return value and if the return value is different to E_OK, the Dcm shall return a NRC 0x10 'GeneralReject'.
